calendars_ingest_coverage_check.name: calendars_ingest_coverage_check
calendars_ingest_coverage_check.value: "ingestHistoricRange" IN ('1_week', '1_month', '3_months', '6_months', '12_months', '2_years') AND "ingestFutureRange" IN ('1_week', '1_month', '3_months', '6_months', '12_months', '2_years') AND (("ingestWindowStart" IS NULL AND "ingestWindowEnd" IS NULL AND "ingestWindowRecordedAt" IS NULL) OR ("ingestWindowStart" IS NOT NULL AND "ingestWindowEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "ingestWindowRecordedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "ingestWindowStart" < "ingestWindowEnd"))

event_mappings_identity_check.name: event_mappings_identity_check
event_mappings_identity_check.value: "event_mappings"."eventStateId" is not null or "event_mappings"."syncEventId" is not null

event_states_recurring_instance_idx.name: event_states_recurring_instance_idx
event_states_recurring_instance_idx.where: "event_states"."sourceEventId" is null and "event_states"."recurrenceId" is not null
